summary: Iter111: Tested Access Alert Rules (trusted_countries), Custody Map in Auditor Room PDF, and Org-Wide Access Globe. All 7 backend pytest cases passed (globe shape+auth, governance GET/PUT trim+dedupe/clear, PDF with & without geo). Frontend: Control Assurance Access Globe (ca-access-globe, access-log-map, ca-globe-refresh) renders KPIs (112 total, 82 opens, 30 downloads, 2 countries) and pins; Refresh works. Agentic AI Security -> Defensibility -> Governance settings: gov-trusted-countries input accepts 'United States, Canada', gov-save fires 'Governance settings saved' toast, value persists after reload. Trusted_countries reset to [] at end.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> rendered as child of <option> for the fire-drill agent picker (dynamic wrapping). Pre-existing, non-blocking, but noisy in console.

governance-settings PUT correctly trims whitespace, drops empty strings, and dedupes case-sensitively, preserving order.
